description:
Creates a new API endpoint doc (page type 4, draft) as the last child of the given page. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Publish it afterwards with Update Endpoint State (parent page must be published).
Body fields:

name (string, optional) - Endpoint title shown in docs.
urlName (string, optional) - URL slug; derived from name if omitted and made unique.
requestType (string, optional) - HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.
URL (string, optional) - Request URL (may contain {{variables}}).
description (string, optional) - Endpoint description (HTML/text).
body (object, optional) - Request body definition, e.g. {"type":"JSON","raw":{"rawType":"JSON","value":"{...}"}}; type can be none, JSON, TEXT, XML, HTML, multipart/form-data, application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
headers (object, optional) - Headers keyed by name: {"Authorization":{"checked":"true","value":"Bearer {{token}}","description":""}}.
params (object, optional) - Query params keyed by name, same shape as headers.
pathVariables (object, optional) - Path variables keyed by index: {"0":{"checked":"notApplicable","key":"id","value":"","description":"Payment id"}}.
bodyDescription (object, optional) - Per-field body docs: {"amount":{"value":100,"type":"number","description":"Amount in cents"}}.
sampleResponse (array, optional) - Sample responses: [{"title":"Success","status":200,"description":"","data":{...}}].
authorizationData (object, optional) - Auth config object (or null).
preScript (string, optional) - Pre-request JavaScript.
postScript (string, optional) - Post-response test JavaScript.
docViewData (array, optional) - Order of doc sections, e.g. [{"type":"host"},{"type":"body"},...]; default set if omitted.
state (number, optional) - 0 pending, 1 draft (default), 2 approved, 3 rejected. Use Update Endpoint State to publish.
uniqueTabId (string, optional) - Optional browser tab id used only to suppress the realtime socket echo to the calling tab; agents can omit it. POST https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/pages/:pageId/endpoints

description.description: e.g. Creates a payment for a customer
